The superior yakuza spin-off game.

-Yagami is a great character that is perfectly believable as both an incredible detective an a complete goofball.
-Combat is an upgrade from Judgment (no more critical wounds and an easier juggling) together with 2 new fighting styles.
-The soundtrack is amazing as always.
-School stories come with fun little minigames.
-I like the story more than the one from Judgment. RGG made an incredible job with the writing and making each character express their emotions in a totally realistic manner.

The only bad thing (if you're going for the 100%) is the robotics club. It's a complete and boring grindfest. Never want to see those nerds ever again after getting everything done.

I have to go with my gut on this.

I don't rate games based on whether they are  """""objectively""""" good or not even though there is no such thing in critique. This game is very well made, the art is incredible, sound is pretty good, controls very well, etc. The problem is this is yet again another Souls-like. Not only am I absolutely tired of the genre, but it pulls some of the worst design decisions of the genre and somehow makes some of them worse. Health vials are needlessly complicated, the concept of a death run is also different for different's sake, no ability to teleport between checkpoints (at least where i was at), etc. Just a lot of decisions that waste your time and I have no interest in wasting my time like that.
For a co-op game the optimization is worse than any other game i've seen yet.

I usually don't play such games and this one was sent to me as a gift so I decided to give it a try. For me it was great but I don't know if it's something new or not. 
I liked the atmosphere and the graphics (the game looks amazing). The weapons are beatiful. The skill tree is huge but easy to navigate. 
As for the drawbacks - it is still early access but the enemies felt repetitive and the enviroments were only rocky mountain ruins and dungeons which could be boring in the long term. Also there are currently no weather conditions, I don't know if this is subject to change or not. 
As a whole - i liked it.

Hades II is rad, as expected! I felt a little let down by the ending at first, but it's grown on me. Plus I haven't reached the epilogue yet, so that might endear me to it even more. Having played Lego Batman 2 over 100 times, I can say that this game is peak. The story telling and the combat are amazing. This game exceeded my expectations. It is most certainly worth the buy.

One of my favourite games of this decade, No, I'm not a Human does a stellar job of creating a sense of fear, doubt, and existential dread. The numerous eccentric characters and endings make the game highly replayable, and the disconcerting art style supplements the ever-present sense of distrust and unease. The melancholic soundtrack is legitimately iconic. I particularly appreciate the quiet introspective moments you can spend looking out the window each night, watching helplessly as the world outside slowly descends into chaos.
Pretty awesome, hopefully update comes out soon but i absolutely love to see the dev having so much fun developing.

Never in my life have i been captivated like this by the visuals of a 2d platformer action game. This game is worth every penny it's asking for, maybe even more. 15 hrs (roughly) felt adequate of a run time for this game. a 100% recommend from me.

The achievments were all very fun, nothing was too tedious, I really like how you keep all your collectibles even when jumping from chapter to chapter. Overall it's an amazing game.

Honestly I don't think Resident Evil (Action era) games get any better than this. Fun, smooth and more than enough game to justify the price tag. Growing up I didn't think anyone could remake 4 and pull it off. Capcom said hold my sake' and did just that. Don't get me wrong the original will always be a tent pole of gaming and changed the landscape of the industry forever but I feel that formula has been perfected here. I could sit here and ramble on and on about what's already been said but I don't think I need to 9.5/10. 

Also a quick side note about the dlc. A lot of people complained about the 10$ price tag for it. Little did they know you had to buy the PS2 version back in the day, so a whole other copy of the game to play separate ways. !0 bones is more than fair for that dlc. Buy the damn game it's really good.

Didn't expect the game to be this deep - it got some vibe to it for sure.
I wish the performance was a bit better, I have to rely on framegen for some decent frames.
It's so beautiful. Unfortunately, it stops exactly there.

So, what can I say?- I thoroughly enjoyed the first game, and the second, is a vast improvement.

The voice acting is fantastic, because of course it is!
The art style is gorgeous!
The combat fluid and responsive
The music is magical
The humour is top tier too!


If you're looking to sink 10-15 Hours into a very nice story, and a world that genuinely feels well thought out and magical, but dark at the same time. This is the game for you. I've 100% it, and the Blood and Brine DLC (I see what the devs did there, iykyk. ) and I can't recommend this game more to my friends.

I was worried this franchise would just end- but with the free expansion my fingers, toes and tail is crossed that we see a Tails of Iron 3 and find out more about the world and story.

10/10.
It's been a while since a game has left thinking about it even after beating the game. It makes me want to start over and play it again.

The game made me feel like when I played Skyrim and Dark Souls for the first time. Both amazing experiences and, if Tainted Grail was as good as in Act I and II during the rest of the game, this could've been one of my favorites.

However, it is clearly unfinished. The end of Act II and the entirety of Act III feel rushed, unfinished, incoherent and buggy as hell. It saddens me because I was loving the experience and even thinking of going NG+ but either I won't or just rush it to get another ending.

If you REALLY want to play THIS SPECIFIC game, you will love it. If you are on the fence, you'd better go mod Skyrim again.
